answer: Give all young keys one fixed pot. Every key under twenty epochs old shares a single newcomer pool whose size never grows with head count, like a marble jar split among whoever reaches in. A farm that spins up a thousand keys just cuts the same walnut into thinner slivers, and honest newcomers lose little. Keys graduate to full pay only after passing audits that sample their past work, so a farm's thin shale of copied answers cracks before it ever earns more.
